about: Document links every client finds in a document's text, in order of first appearance, each once. The text itself is shown unchanged.

links.text:
# Garden release plan

Owner: the orchard team. See [the checklist](doc/garden/checklist) and doc/garden/notes@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.

## Steps

1. Prepare
   - Read doc/garden/checklist again (listed once).
   - Nested:
     1. Water the beds
     2. Check `doc/garden/soil.md`.
2. Ship
   * Tell mydoc/not-a-link or https://example.com/doc/not-a-link either.

| Bed | Owner | Notes |
|-----|-------|-------|
| North | Ada | doc/garden/beds/north |
| South | Lin | — |

```kdl
step "plant" {
  document "doc/garden/seeds@aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
}
```

> Quoted: (doc/garden/quote).

A reference that ends a sentence: doc/garden/last.
Malformed: doc/ and doc/garden/@nothing and doc/garden/short@abc.
